blurb:
I hold a Master's degree in Computer Science and build highly scalable distributed systems for production financial products. My work spans backend services, full stack applications, and the operational rigor needed when correctness, compliance, and load all matter at once.

I've worked in financial services and mortgage technology for years, shipping platforms that families and institutions rely on daily. Happy to talk if you're hiring, want to collaborate, or are curious about something below.
